title: Leche Asada
hookLine: Global-inspired leche asada with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Leche Asada
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Keep {m53519_1}, {m53519_2}, {m53519_3}, and {m53519_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Leche Asada
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the milk into a saucepan along with the lemon zest and cinnamon sticks. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low, and cook for 5 minutes. Turn heat off, and allow to steep for 15 minutes. Incorporate {m53519_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Leche Asada
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently beat the eggs and sugar together until the sugar has dissolved. Slowly beat in 1 cup of the hot milk, a little at a time, until it has been incorporated. Stir the egg mixture back into the hot milk, pour in the pisco, and mix until well combined.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Leche Asada
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the custard through a fine mesh sieve into a 2-quart ceramic casserole dish to remove the lemon zest and cinnamon. Bake in preheated oven until set, and browned on top, about 30 minutes. Chill before serving.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 38 mins!
